text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  run_nra:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/run_nra.yml
    with:
      branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      repo: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name || github.repository }}
    secrets: inherit
```
